cohort: The cohort consisted of pregnant women in Eastern Uganda who were enrolled at 34 weeks of gestation or more and followed to birth.
finding: The incidence of term stillbirths in Eastern Uganda was 18.4 per 1000 births, with prolonged/obstructed labour and malaria being common causes, and caesarean birth, intimate partner violence, and advanced maternal age identified as associated risk factors.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was identified as a factor associated with term stillbirths (aRR 3.3; 95% CI 2.00 to 5.4).
